# Subprocessors Page

[Download PDF](https://framerusercontent.com/assets/00xagUvjBNiZbLKmA1RosVDSu4.pdf)

3.0

·

Last updated

Oct 1, 2026

| **These are the subprocessors Luminance currently uses to provide the Product (including any additional features) and Support. This page is referenced by the Data Processing Addendum (“DPA”); if we add or replace a subprocessor we follow the notice and objection process in the DPA.** |
| Sub-processor | Nature and purpose of processing | Categories of personal data | Location of processing |
| **PRODUCT & CUSTOMER DATA HOSTING** |
| AWS | Cloud hosting of the Product and Customer Data. | Determined by the Customer. Any personal data contained in the Customer Data (documents) uploaded to the Product. For example, names, contact details, and any personal data within the Customer’s documents. | As set out in the Product Order Form, and in accordance with the locations at aws.amazon.com/compliance/sub-processors. |
| **INFRASTRUCTURE PROVIDERS Customer Data is not sent to an external model provider.** |
| AWS | In-cloud Additional Generative Model processing. | Determined by the Customer. Any personal data contained in the inputs submitted to the feature utilising Additional Generative Models. | As set out in the Product Order Form, and in accordance with the locations at aws.amazon.com/compliance/sub-processors. |
| Microsoft Azure | In-cloud Additional Generative Model processing. | Determined by the Customer. Any personal data contained in the inputs submitted to the feature utilising Additional Generative Models. | Follows the hosting region set out in the Product Order Form: EU/UK if the Product is hosted in the EU/UK; otherwise an international location. |
| Google Cloud EMEA Limited | In-cloud Additional Generative Model processing. | Determined by the Customer. Any personal data contained in the inputs submitted to the feature utilising Additional Generative Models. | Follows the hosting region set out in the Product Order Form: EU/UK if the Product is hosted in the EU/UK; otherwise an international location. |
| **GENERATIVE MODEL PROVIDERS Customer inputs are sent to the provider.** |
| OpenAI, L.L.C | Additional Generative Model processing, accessed via the provider’s API. | Determined by the Customer. Any personal data contained in the inputs submitted to the feature utilising Additional Generative Models. | United States |
| **SUPPORT & OPERATIONS** |
| Luminance, Inc | 24/7 support services. | Authorised users’ contact and account data (e.g. name, email), and any personal data the Customer includes in a support request. | United States |
| Luminance Technologies Australia Pty Limited | 24/7 support services. | Authorised users’ contact and account data (e.g. name, email), and any personal data the Customer includes in a support request. | Australia |
| Intercom R&D Unlimited Company | Customer support tooling and communications. | Authorised users’ contact and account data (e.g. name, email), and any personal data the Customer includes in a support request. | European Union and/or United States (United States on request) |
| Mango Technologies, Inc. (ClickUp) | Support and operations tooling (ticketing and workflow). | Authorised users’ contact and account data (e.g. name, email), and any personal data the Customer includes in a support request. | European Union |
| OpenAI, L.L.C | Agentic workflows (Codex) used in the support of the Product | Authorised users’ contact and account data (e.g. name, email), and any personal data the Customer includes in a support request. | European Union |

**Categories of personal data.** Because the Product processes documents and inputs supplied by the Customer, the Customer determines the categories of personal data processed. These may include special categories of personal data (Article 9 UK/EU GDPR) and personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences (Article 10). The Customer is responsible for establishing a lawful basis, and any additional conditions, for such processing.

**International transfers.** For any transfer of personal data outside the UK/EEA (including to the United States), Luminance relies on the transfer safeguards set out in the DPA (Standard Contractual Clauses and/or the EU-U.S., UK and Swiss Data Privacy Framework).
